Main
================================================================================

James T. Durant {#title}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### MSPH, CIH

Certified Industrial Hygienist and Environmental Health Scientist with more than 20 years of experience in environmental exposure assessment, industrial hygiene, risk assessment, air dispersion modeling, and environmental data analysis. Senior Industrial Hygienist with Hydro-Environmental Technologies, Inc. (HETI), providing technical support to insurance carriers, attorneys, and property owners on environmental issues associated with property and liability claims. Holds the CIH credential (Board for Global EHS Credentialing) and an MSPH in Industrial Hygiene from the University of Alabama at Birmingham.

### Senior Industrial Hygienist

Hydro-Environmental Technologies, Inc. (HETI)

Atlanta, GA

2025 - Present

- Provide technical support to insurance carriers, attorneys, and property owners regarding environmental and industrial hygiene issues associated with property and liability claims.
- Conduct technical reviews of remediation scopes, contractor estimates, and invoices to evaluate the reasonableness and necessity of remediation costs.
- Evaluate claims involving mold contamination, indoor air quality complaints, water intrusion, Legionella concerns, and hazardous materials exposure.
- Develop analytical workflows in **R** for environmental data analysis, modeling, and visualization supporting claim evaluation.

### Environmental Health Scientist (Exposure Investigation Section, GS-14)

Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry (ATSDR)

Atlanta, GA

2019 - 2025

- Performed statistical analysis and visualization of ethylene oxide air sampling data from sterilization and chemical plants, demonstrating reductions following emission controls.
- Compared biomonitoring data from community investigations with age-adjusted NHANES data to evaluate lead and arsenic exposure.
- Developed an R package implementing EPA’s Johnson and Ettinger vapor intrusion model with probabilistic and visualization enhancements.
